blocks.text: About Us
History and Mission
Quality and Safety Since 2008
AIoT P.S.A. Research and Training Centre, Paweł Matysiak, has been operating since 2008 under entry no 17344 in the Business Activity Register.
The quality and safety of the services we provide are a matter of awareness for everyone involved in establishing and maintaining AIoT P.S.A.’s declared standards of operation.
Our wide-ranging activities demonstrate the appropriate quality when the work we carry out meets the requirements agreed with the client, bringing them maximum benefit.
To ensure the appropriate quality, AIoT P.S.A. implements, maintains and improves a Management System in accordance with the requirements of the PN-EN ISO/IEC 17025 standard.

blocks.eyebrow: CLIENT AND HIGHEST QUALITY IN FOCUS
blocks.text: Strategic Company Goals
Our company’s strategic objective is:
Trust and credibility
To build trust and credibility among existing and new clients
Client orientation
To take the needs and interests of our clients into account in a structured manner
Quality guarantee
To ensure a high standard of quality in the services provided by AIoT P.S.A.
Reliable execution
To fulfil orders in accordance with the arrangements made with the client
Confirmed competence (PCA)
To confirm the Laboratory’s competence by obtaining PCA accreditation
How we deliver our objectives
The AIoT P.S.A. team achieves its strategic objectives by
1. Quality Planning
Planning of activities aimed at ensuring the quality of services provided by AIoT P.S.A. at all levels of the company’s organisation related to these services
2. Confidentiality and Impartiality
Impartiality, confidentiality and professionalism in the provision of services, on the basis that whoever we deal with becomes a client whose needs and requirements must be met
3. Timely Reporting
The timely preparation of a measurement report/service report containing all the information required by our client, compiled in an objective, clear and transparent manner,
4. Awareness of Objectives
Staff awareness of the objectives set out in the policy in accordance with the requirements of the management system,
5. Proven Methods
The use of documented methods and good engineering practices, the applicability of which is confirmed by validation
6. Qualified Team
Experienced and qualified staff, who are provided with opportunities for continuous professional development
7. ISO Standards
Maintaining and improving the management system, which ensures that all requirements of the ISO 9001:2015 standard are met continuously
Full Commitment to the Management System

All AIoT P.S.A. staff are involved in the management system and are familiar with, accept, and apply the Quality Policy and the system procedures contained in the Quality Manual and related documents. The management of AIoT P.S.A. declares that it will provide all necessary resources to implement the Quality Policy above.
